label: computed
note: Scores from scripts/brier.py through scripts/build_grade.py. A Brier score is the squared gap between the chance given and what happened (1 or 0), averaged: 0 is perfect, 0.25 is a coin flip on every race. Ratings (Toss-up, Lean, Likely, Safe) are scored as the chances they were converted to on the day: 50, 60 for Tilt, 70, 85 and 97 percent.

resolutions.policy: resolved only on a call or certified result shown by the source; counts and margins derived with the arithmetic shown
